svg.text: Repossession tow truck · Silas Crane — contestant vehicle dossier
“Everything in this town has a price and a due date.”
Clocks, wedding rings, a child’s bicycle
A wheelchair bolted to the roof
A heavy black repossession tow truck with a
hydraulic boom and large hook, draped with the
trophies of the ruined — grandfather clocks, a
child's bicycle, wedding rings on a chain, a
wheelchair on the roof, grimy and oppressive,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~60k tris · PBR 4K
Separate: boom, hook, hung props, wheels
